_doc: City life. Weather is rolled per day (with a forecast for tomorrow); footfall multiplies shoppers, mix multiplies what they come in for, sky is the Atmosphere weather shown. Events: at most one new one a day (chance), weighted; each lasts `days`. Rivals: the QuikSave chain opens stores in free units and competes for shoppers; buy them out at price_k x the premises price.
